# Vendored Dependencies

This directory is reserved for third-party artifacts vendored into the repository when legally and technically appropriate (e.g. immutable, reviewed source needed for reproducibility).

## Current state
No third-party artifacts are vendored in this initial build.

## Requirements for any vendored artifact
- Source URL/repository and exact version/tag/commit.
- License text or reference and compatibility confirmation.
- Purpose/integration notes and update procedure.
- Security review notes.
